terra.problem: The line and first moment say the spies began or went up from Zin. Numbers 13:21 describes the extent of their search, from Zin to Rehob, but does not say they started at Zin. The fruit was gathered at the Valley of Eshcol, which the passage does not locate in Zin.
The first moment says there were twelve spies, but Numbers 13:21–27 does not give their number. Include the earlier verses that identify the men, or omit the number.
